result.brief: 提出多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型，用跨步高层上下文通道与上下文感知路由的专家混合抑制自回归 rollout 漂移，提升离线决策效率。
result.reason: Hierarchical world-action model with multi-timescale latent context and MoE routing for decision making; contributes world model architecture reducing rollout drift, though evaluated on Atari offline RL.
